name: Symbol of the Holy
body:
Symbol of the Holy (Su)
Source Mythic Adventures pg. 35
As a standard action, you can create a wooden holy symbol dedicated to your deity. If it ever leaves your possession, it fades away after 1 hour. Whenever you use this holy symbol as a divine focus when casting a spell, you don't need to have any other material component, unless that component costs more than 50 gp per tier you possess.
